answer: Peers verify the pulse against a rotating beacon and slash the stake for duplicate or missing signals. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from a slow, costly proof-of-work tied to its identity, then broadcast a signed pulse every epoch. Faking a thousand identities means paying a thousand times the minting cost plus continuous pulse upkeep, so sybil farming collapses under compounding expense. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
